topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Employee handbook code of conduct; security duties now in POL-01 and POL-05; acknowledgments not yet collected
gap: No signed acknowledgments of security rules
remediation: Collect POL-05 acknowledgments from staff and contractors

control_description: Majority owner approves budget and High risks; no regular security reporting to the owner
gap: No recurring owner oversight of security
remediation: Quarterly security report to the COO and majority owner (P03 G-002)

control_description: COO is program owner; IT Manager designated security lead; Director of Engineering and Security Manager named owners of building systems; risk acceptance levels in POL-01 4.4
Background checks at hire for security staff; annual awareness video; no OT or role training
gap: No role-based OT training for engineers and console operators

control_description: Sanctions statement in POL-01 4.7; not yet applied; contractor duties not in contracts
gap: Accountability for contractors not written into contracts

control_description: Corporate device inventory exists; no OT inventory, network diagrams, or central logs
gap: No reliable information on OT devices, flows, or events
remediation: OT inventory and diagrams (POAM-013); log service (POAM-015)

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies approved 2026-08-31 and posted; not yet trained or acknowledged; no published incident line
gap: Policies and reporting line not communicated

control_description: Lease notice clauses and tenant contacts known to Property Managers; notification matrix approved (P08); no tenant-facing notice on access control and video data
gap: No notice to tenants and visitors about badge, video, and analytics data

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Security objectives set by adopting CPG 2.0 as the baseline; risk tolerance in POL-01
First risk assessment completed 2026-07-24 with SP 800-30 (34 risks)
Payment fraud (bank detail change) identified as R-010; no call-back rule yet
gap: No call-back verification for vendor bank changes

control_description: Vendor-enabled video analytics and the planned BAS upgrade were not risk-assessed before change
gap: Significant changes are not assessed before they happen
remediation: Change control with risk review (POAM-014; POL-01 4.10)

control_description: First independent control assessment 2026-08-03 to 2026-08-07; MSP external scan July 2026; no ongoing monitoring
gap: No ongoing evaluation between annual assessments
remediation: Quarterly POA&M and metric review with the COO

control_description: Deficiencies tracked in the POA&M (22 items) with owners and dates

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected against the risk register and CPG gaps; OT controls mostly planned
gap: OT control activities not yet in place

control_description: General IT controls in place for corporate systems (MFA, EDR, patching); weak for OT
gap: No technology general controls for the BAS

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Five policies approved 2026-08-31; procedures for OT accounts, change, and contingency pending
gap: Procedures not written
remediation: Procedures due with POAM-008, POAM-011, POAM-014

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: Identity provider with MFA for corporate SaaS, cloud, and the platform portal; BAS uses shared local accounts without MFA
evidence: Identity provider export; BAS user list
gap: BAS logical access relies on a shared account and no MFA
remediation: Named accounts and gateway MFA (POAM-003, POAM-010)

control_description: Corporate accounts created from approved HR tickets; tenant badges approved by tenant contacts
gap: Integrator and guard accounts created without approval records
remediation: Approval records for all vendor accounts

control_description: Accounts disabled about 3 business days after departure; 212 stale tenant badges; 9 full platform administrators
gap: Late removal and excess privileges

control_description: Badge readers and cameras on the Property A server room and engineering rooms; console staffed 24x7
MSP destroys retired corporate drives; NVR drives returned unwiped; paper card data kept in a binder
gap: Disposal not controlled for OT media and paper

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Firewalls with no inbound services; NVR port forward removed; integrator always-on tool bypasses the boundary
gap: Remote-support tool and flat OT networks

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS and IPsec for cloud connections; card data received by email; BACnet unencrypted (compensated by planned segmentation)
gap: Card numbers reach the events mailbox
remediation: Data loss prevention rule for card numbers (P04)

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on corporate endpoints and console PCs; signature antivirus on engineering workstations; nothing on the BAS server; USB allowed on engineering workstations
gap: BAS server unprotected; removable media uncontrolled

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: External scan July 2026; no internal or OT vulnerability monitoring; BAS audit trail disabled
gap: No detection of OT configuration changes or vulnerabilities

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: MSP monitors EDR and identity alerts 24x7; no OT, firewall, or remote access monitoring
gap: No monitoring of OT events

control_description: MSP triages EDR alerts; no criteria for OT events
gap: No OT event criteria
remediation: OT alert rules with the log service (POAM-015)

control_description: POL-03 and the BAS ransomware runbook approved 2026-08-31; not exercised
gap: Untested

control_description: No tested BAS recovery; backups exposed; no manual operating procedures
gap: BAS could not be reliably rebuilt

control_description: MSP tickets for corporate changes; no change control for BAS programs or vendor features
gap: No OT change management

control_description: BIA done (P05); cyber insurance in place; no contingency plan
gap: No contingency plan

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Access control platform SOC 2 reviewed (vendor-soc2-review.csv); integrators, MSP, guard, and visitor management vendors have no security terms
gap: Integrators and MSP unmanaged
